evidence_slice: Rushcliffe Borough Council's current Ratcliffe Local Development Order page states that revisions to the Ratcliffe on Soar LDO were approved on 12 May 2026, that the LDO was originally adopted on 13 July 2023, and that it grants planning permission for redevelopment of the Ratcliffe on Soar power station site. The current Planning Online record 25/02015/LDO identifies proposed revisions to the Ratcliffe on Soar Local Development Order at Uniper UK Ratcliffe On Soar Power Station, Green Street, Ratcliffe On Soar, Nottinghamshire NG11 0EE; the record was received 24 November 2025 and validated 27 November 2025. The original Planning Online record 22/01339/LDO records the proposed Local Development Order for the same power-station site and a decision of Grant consent subject to conditions issued 19 July 2023.

field_evidence.site_address: Uniper UK Ratcliffe On Soar Power Station, Green Street, Ratcliffe On Soar, Nottinghamshire, NG11 0EE
field_evidence.planning_effect: The LDO grants planning permission for redevelopment of the Ratcliffe on Soar power station site.
field_evidence.site_context: The power station closed in September 2024; the site is part of the East Midlands Freeport.
